Taylor Swift announces new single 'Patient Zero', faces backlash

Singer Taylor Swift has announced a new single titled 'Patient Zero'. The announcement has led to backlash from some fans, particularly concerning the cover art for the song. Fans expressed excitement about the new release, with some describing themselves as 'shaking'.
